coloredlight.options.title: Colored Light
coloredlight.options.enabled.tooltip: Block light takes on the color of the block giving it off: soul fire glows blue, redstone glows red.
coloredlight.options.intensity.tooltip: How strongly light is colored. 0% looks like vanilla, 100% is fully colored.
coloredlight.options.glass_strength.tool: How strongly stained glass tints light. 0% = glass barely tints, 100% = default, 300% = extreme.
coloredlight.options.stained_glass.toolt: Light that passes through stained glass picks up the color of the glass.
coloredlight.options.reset.tooltip: Put every Colored Light setting back to how it started.
